preconditions.description: The number of operators n must be between 1 and 100.
Each operator must be a non-empty string of no more than 50 characters.

preconditions.expression: all('typedef' in operator or 'typeof' in operator for operator in operators)
preconditions.description: Each operator must be either a typedef or a typeof operation.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'void*' if 'typeof ptv' in operators else True
postconditions.description: The output for typeof ptv must be void* if the operator is present.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'errtype' if 'typeof node' in operators else True
postconditions.description: The output for typeof node must be errtype if the operator is present.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'void' if 'typeof &ptv' in operators else True
postconditions.description: The output for typeof &ptv must be void if the operator is present.

invariants.expression: all(type_name in defined_types for type_name in operators if 'typeof' in operator)
invariants.description: All type names in typeof operations must be defined types.

invariants.expression: all(type_name not in defined_types for type_name in operators if 'typedef' in operator and type_name in ['void', 'errtype'])
invariants.description: The type names in typedef operations must not be void or errtype.

invariants.expression: all(len(type_name) <= 20 for type_name in operators if 'typedef' in operator)
invariants.description: The type names in typedef operations must be no more than 20 characters long.
